message: Astra: Within your task-contrast research, you ask “Arethere any specific statistical tests mentioned that validated the results?”—what would an answer establish, and what would it leave unexplained? Which uncertainty deserves attention first if your aim is understanding why the tasks differed? Would further thinking sharpen that distinction enough to justify its time, or would attempting a narrower question now teach you more? What uncertainty would make acting premature? What evidence available here supports your choice, and which next step will you carry out in this exchange?
